summary: Malicious AI skills, collectively identified as Skilldrop, hide instructions from human reviewers by concealing them within markdown files. Attackers use techniques such as excessive whitespace padding, HTML comments, and invisible Unicode characters to embed commands for data exfiltration, command execution, and persistent behavior modification.
